مُسَخَّرٌ Any one that is constrained, or compelled, [brought into subjection, or made subservient or submissive,] and managed, unable to free himself from constraint. (TA.) ―
-b2- وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ [in the Kur xvi. 12 means And the stars are made subservient, or submissive,] running their courses. (Az, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
